headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for the Polyaire AirTouch 2+ ducted air conditioning controller. Connects over the local network on port 9200.

host.title: AirTouch 2+ IP Address
host.description: The local IP address of your AirTouch 2+ console. A static DHCP lease is recommended.

port.title: Port
port.description: TCP port for the AirTouch 2+ API. Leave at 9200 unless you know otherwise.

exposeZones.title: Expose Zones
exposeZones.description: Expose each zone (group) as a fan accessory with damper control.

exposeFanSpeed.title: Expose Fan Speed Control
exposeFanSpeed.description: Adds a separate Fan tile to control AC fan speed (Low/Med/High/Auto). Apple Home cannot show the fan slider on the AC tile itself, so this provides it as its own accessory.

exposeFanMode.title: Expose Fan-Only Mode
exposeFanMode.description: Adds a separate Fan tile that switches the AC into FAN-only mode (air circulation, no heating/cooling). Turning it on sets FAN mode; turning it off turns the AC off. Useful for overnight air circulation.

exposeDryMode.title: Expose Dry Mode
exposeDryMode.description: Adds a separate tile that switches the AC into DRY (dehumidify) mode. Turning it on sets DRY mode; turning it off turns the AC off.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to refresh state from the console. Minimum 15 seconds.

setpointMin.title: Fallback Minimum Setpoint (°C)
setpointMin.description: Used only if your unit reports an unusable setpoint range. Your controller's real range (check Preferences) is typically 12.

setpointMax.title: Fallback Maximum Setpoint (°C)
setpointMax.description: Used only if your unit reports an unusable setpoint range.
